messages:
Maya: Quick UX pass on the model catalog compare view. Found a few small wins: visible column grip, clearer badging semantics, safer pin wording, and keyboard-accessible chips. Short takes?

Sam: The divider is draggable today but invisible. Users expect a visible grip. Can we show a slim handle on hover and make it focusable? :eyes:

Olivia: I can mock a 6px hover handle with focus styles. Also add an explicit aria-label so screen readers announce it.

Jordan: Keyboard behavior: when the handle is focused support Left/Right to nudge width and announce changes via aria-live. Ensure resize doesn't trap keyboard focus.

Sasha: Badge semantics are muddy—green means multiple things. Recommend icon + single-meaning color tokens: green=meets SLO, blue=cached, amber=borderline, red=regress.

Aria: Pin microcopy is scary: "Pin version" + "Lock" reads like immutability. Suggest CTA: "Pin for compare" and tooltip: "Keep this version visible in compare view".

Maya: Also the pinned mark is only on rows; add a tiny pin glyph in the compare header so pinned columns are obvious and include tooltip "Pinned — stays in compare".

Sam: Small flow question: allow unpin from header? Current path is buried in overflow.

Olivia: Yes, make header pin a direct toggle. For org-level pins keep confirmation; for regular pins, quick toggle + undo toast works.

Jordan: Chip accessibility: collapsed chips behind "More" break linear tab order. Ensure the More button exposes aria-expanded and popover chips are reachable first in DOM when opened.

Sasha: Chip ordering: recency is confusing. Let's switch to "most used" by default and show a tiny label "(sorted by usage)".

Maya: Plan: 1) add visible handle + keyboard nudge (Olivia) 2) update badge tokens + icons (Sasha) 3) change pin copy + header toggle + undo toast (Aria) 4) make chips accessible + reorder by usage (Jordan). Prototype by EOW for quick user check.

Olivia: I'll drop Figma frames today.

Sasha: Color + icon proposal by Thu.

Aria: Copy + toast text by Fri.

Jordan: Accessibility spec by Thu evening.

Maya: I'll assemble PR notes once artifacts land. :rocket:
